meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: Claude 会比较当前代码与最新发布的 npm 版本，列出所有未发布的改动，按三个发布层（纯组件、OpenCode、Codex）分类，并推荐各层及整体的版本号。
howto.when: 当用户提到 'unpublished changes'、'changelog'、'what changed' 等词，或询问有什么新变化时触发。

say.text: 看看有哪些未发布的更改
say.note: Claude 会比较 HEAD 与已发布版本并列出改动。

say.text: 整理一下 changelog，按发布层分组
say.note: Claude 会按各发布层分组。

say.text: 这些改动需要什么版本号？
say.note: Claude 会推荐各层及整体的版本升幅。

howto.what_en: Claude compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions, lists unpublished changes by release layer, and recommends semver bumps per layer and overall.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user mentions 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', etc., or asks what's new.

say_en.note: Claude compares HEAD with published versions.

say_en.text: Summarize the changelog by release layer

say_en.note: Claude recommends per-layer and overall bumps.
